response.query: How will vendor enrollment rules be designed to avoid excluding small vendors or marginalized consumers, which equity subgroups will be pre-specified, and what interaction tests will assess differential impacts?
response.answer: Vendor enrollment rules will prioritize inclusivity to avoid excluding small vendors or marginalized consumers. Pre-specified equity subgroups include small businesses and minority-owned firms. Interaction tests will assess differential impacts on these groups.
